definitions.explanation: The curved bones that form the rib cage, protecting the heart and lungs. Humans have 12 pairs of ribs.

notes:
ANATOMY:
Humans have 12 pairs (24 total) of {肋骨|ろっこつ}:
- 7 pairs of ⟦{真肋|しんろく}→真肋：noentry⟧ (true ribs): attached directly to sternum
- 3 pairs of ⟦{仮肋|かろく}→仮肋：noentry⟧ (false ribs): attached indirectly
- 2 pairs of ⟦{浮遊肋|ふゆうろく}→浮遊肋：noentry⟧ (floating ribs): not attached to sternum

MEDICAL TERMS:
- ⟦{肋骨骨折|ろっこつこっせつ}→肋骨骨折：noentry⟧: rib fracture
- ⟦{肋間|ろっかん}→肋間：noentry⟧: intercostal (between ribs)
- ⟦{肋間筋|ろっかんきん}→肋間筋：noentry⟧: intercostal muscles
